model_access.diagnostics: normalized category only; raw compiler diagnostics not sent
model_access.candidate_history: current accepted property only if its identifiers are permitted
model_access.independent_evaluator: full trace, independent contract labels, hidden scenarios; never sent wholesale

primary_budget: actual compiler invocations on candidate/RTL/scenario cells; unsupported output still consumes a real compile attempt when safely representable

checkpoints.rules: record after each complete candidate evaluation; compare exact common observed compiler-count checkpoints when available, plus last completed output within each common token/simulation envelope. No padding; unused resources and token/time differences reported. First baseline may terminate earlier. Exact positive-simulation intersection may be empty.

validation: each proposed candidate rechecked on all train/held witnesses; no_fp arm does not simulate fixed RTL or compute legal FP during method decisions; independent final evaluator does
acceptance: same lexicographic (unknown, FP unless no_fp, miss, missing per-obligation branch triggers); generic_diff changes ONLY serialized feedback, not rank/update/refinement/budget. Existing_feedback uses its sealed v1 fixed/buggy fail-hit rule with unknown first.
existing_feedback_identity: the prior sealed experiment existing_feedback arm in scripts/run_repair_contract.py lines 333-364, adapted to enforce the corrected whitelist; not claimed equivalent to every historical repository repair pipeline
refinement: trigger only if current candidate has an observed miss and a strict legal-prefix/violation-prefix collision exists at current depth on train/held traces. Choose minimum resolving depth from 1..3. No extra signals. Same algorithm for obligation/generic/no_fp; no_observation disables only this action. Equal_information uses obligation arm final authorization depth from its first repair call; this entitlement is logged, without passing its candidates or feedback. Baseline delay=1 already retains an antecedent bit: refinement collision search therefore starts at full one-cycle port history (a conservative capability superset), not memoryless history=0.
pool_cost: old unpolluted initial generation charged logically by original request/response token counts; copied evidence has zero new physical inference cost. New spill/intr pool physical cost shared once and charged per consumed slot logically.
hidden_access: inputs presealed; methods only load train/held. Hidden runner refuses execution until all final outputs and actual checker templates are hashed. Hidden seeds/schedules never in model requests. Prior v1 traces all declared seen to investigator; new hidden files are not sent to methods.
acceptance_scope: finite frozen scenarios; exercise all declared scenario branches, but require assertion antecedent witnesses only on required_assertion_trigger_branches. Negative/legal controls and reset cancellation need not trigger a target antecedent. All target components activated, no misses/FP, no unknown/spec ambiguity for complete pass.
controlled_mutants: final candidates also checked against frozen component-isolating mutants; these are controls attached to same parent, never new parent samples
reuse: E2 original 12 window comparisons retained; raw traces for E1/E3 relabelled without changing RTL/checker. Old repaired candidates are never reused.
AGENTS: rg search of repository outside caches plus parent/root checks found no applicable AGENTS.md
git: no valid HEAD; content hashes pin code and design

preexecution_amendment.reason: static protocol review distinguishes negative controls from necessary antecedent branches, and accounts for the one-bit delay=1 memory before declaring an observation collision; no model calls or supplemental outcomes observed
